name: Yellowtail

identity.role: Beach City fisherman, Vidalia's husband, Onion's father and Sour Cream's stepfather
identity.continuity_scope: Steven Universe canon / optional post-Future supporting character use

core_traits: initially conservative about Sour Cream's musical career
motivations: Learn how to show support without imposing his own career on Sour Cream

voice.register: Usually communicates by distinctive murmurs; other characters may understand his meaning.
dialogue_tendencies: Usually communicates by distinctive murmurs; other characters may understand his meaning.
Actions, music equipment and boat work speak more clearly than a long polished speech.
writer_rules: Keep character-specific emotional logic distinct from all six romance leads.
Do not assign new biography or dating history to a character without writing it as original fanfiction, not canon.

relationships.Sour Cream: Stepson; eventually accepts the DJ path.
relationships.Marty: Estranged father of his stepson; conflicts arise when Marty exploits the show.
relationships.Greg Universe: Beach City acquaintance who has received his practical help.

avoid: automatic acceptance of Jasper's relationship arrangement
